page.layout: One page of text. Running head with page number at the top. Below it, a continuous text block of full-width lines, then a centred woodcut ornament with a psalm reference, italic verse and speaker's name below it. No margin notes.

main_text.p: amemus, spiremus, imitemur, celebremus, & in ipso in sempiternum unum esse exoptemus.
Cætera Magnificus Dominus Cancellarius, Illustrissimi Principis nomine, iam est edicturus.
Gratia Domini nostri Iesu Christi sit cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
main_text.head: PSAL: 119.

p.i: Superbi deriserunt me plurimùm: à doctrina tamen tua non discessi[?].

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a cherub between scrolls, masks, and foliage, with a pendant below) is an illustration and is not transcribed. The page number "15" at top right is faint and may be read differently. The word "discessi" is hard to read in the scan and may be "discesi". The printed "ERASMVS" is set in spaced capitals and is treated as a speaker's name, not a heading. Faint show-through of the other side is visible, including a mark resembling "clɔ." near the lower right; it is not transcribed. The last line is printed as "laudariest." and is copied as printed.
